subject: general
question: The famous santoor player Pandit Shivkumar Sharma received the ___________________ in the year 1986.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists.
 
• Pandit Shivkumar Sharma, an eminent santoor player, received this prestigious award in 1986.
 
• This award is presented by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India’s National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• The award includes a cash prize, a citation, and a memento, recognizing outstanding contributions to the performing arts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi**

 
 
• Established in 1952, the Sangeet Natak Akademi is the national level academy for performing arts set up by the Government of India.
 
• It aims to promote and preserve the vast and diverse cultural heritage of India's performing arts.
 
• The Akademi also supports and encourages the practice of traditional arts and fosters their development.
 
• It organizes numerous programs, workshops, and festivals to promote music, dance, and drama across the country.
 
 
 
• **Kalidas Samman**
 
 
• An esteemed arts award presented annually by the government of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It honors outstanding achievement in the fields of classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts.
 
• The award is named after the classical Sanskrit author Kalidasa.
 
• The award includes a cash prize, a memento, and a citation.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra Gaurav Puraskar**
 
 
• Presented by the government of Maharashtra, this award recognizes notable contributions in various fields such as arts, sports, social work, and more.
 
• The award aims to honor those who have brought pride to the state through their achievements.
 
• It includes a cash prize and a citation.
 
 
 
• **Sanskriti Award**
 
 
• Initiated by the Sanskriti Pratishthan, a non-profit organization promoting Indian culture and heritage.
 
• It recognizes young talent in fields like literature, arts, music, dance, and social/cultural activism.
 
• The award includes a cash prize and a citation, encouraging the young generation to contribute to Indian cultural heritage.
